g.title: MarieRank4Convo5 begins.
g.text: MarieRank4Convo5 begins.

g.title: j437277583
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonAvailable is now true.

g.title: j1316635360
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1568845637
g.text: Drifter ! I have been scheming.

g.title: j1316635360->j1568845637
g.text: LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j1704363217
g.text: Drifter ! I have been scheming, thinking over what you said of the family above us. And how they might see us as interlopers.

g.title: j1316635360->j1704363217
g.text: MarieFamilyOther

g.title: j1219003284
g.text: Drifter ! I have been thinking over what you said of the family above us. My heart breaks for them...

g.title: j1316635360->j1219003284
g.text: MarieFamily2

g.title: j1316635360->j1219003284
g.text: MarieFamily1

g.title: j2916189223
g.text: Why is it we cannot go upstairs ? Why can we not speak to those who called le Cardinal famille ?

g.title: j1316635360->j2916189223
g.text: false

g.title: j3958838742
g.text: Should I be scared?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j883296813
g.text: As the "other family" in compétition, oui ? This troubles me so.

g.title: j1000557311
g.text: Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank(syndicate=EntratiSyndicate, syndicateRank=5)

g.title: j1815650644
g.text: Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.

g.title: j1773318919
g.text: Oui ! The little flying robots. The necra... necra... What do you call them ?

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3214280635
g.text: We do not compete for the love of le Cardinal, how can we help them see this ?

g.title: j1000557311->j3214280635
g.text: true

g.title: j3642914
g.text: Check boolean MarieSyndicateMaxRank

g.title: j1000557311->j3642914
g.text: false

g.title: j463626933
g.text: Boolean MarieFamily1 is now true.

g.title: j2451213109
g.text: Necramites?

g.title: j901043021
g.text: You're right. You can't compete for something a person doesn't have to give.

g.title: j814782805
g.text: Opening scabbed-over wounds is dangerous. You might get rid of an infection... or you might bleed out in the process.

g.title: j1655123363
g.text: You - we - all have one thing in common. At some point, we were left behind by Entrati.

g.title: j3642914->j3214280635
g.text: true

g.title: j3572447746
g.text: How goes your work mending their inner strife ?

g.title: j3642914->j3572447746
g.text: false

g.title: j2459680150
g.text: Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!

g.title: j915966119
g.text: Oui ! Ha ! They are so persistent in replacing furniture, non ? But I find if you move things... they do the same thing.

g.title: j380005824
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2952898253
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2515192195
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j421942424
g.text: Honestly? I got distracted.

g.title: j3624308954
g.text: It could be going better.

g.title: j304566815
g.text: I'm making progress.

g.title: j3420657757
g.text: His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.

g.title: j1031291885
g.text: What is to stop us from simply moving all the furniture, letting them replace it all, and then... doing it again ? We could sell it all ! Make profit de ce mobilier étrange !

g.title: j179815407
g.text: I am well aware of our unsettled disagreements regarding le Cardinal. I am attempting to keep this conversation civilisée.

g.title: j380005824->j179815407
g.text: MarieEntrati3a

g.title: j380005824->j179815407
g.text: MarieEntrati3b

g.title: j380005824->j179815407
g.text: MarieEntrati3

g.title: j2734738403
g.text: I understand how you may not wish to discuss mending rifts without finding opportunities to point at those you feel are to blame.

g.title: j380005824->j2734738403
g.text: MarieEntratiFamily

g.title: j380005824->j2734738403
g.text: false

g.title: j3873709173
g.text: Oui ! As you are so often wont to remind me, you believe him to be un monstre ! With nothing but spite and emptiness in his heart !

g.title: j380005824->j3873709173
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster1

g.title: j380005824->j3873709173
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster2

g.title: j2930639881
g.text: I thought you were on my side in this war for le Cardinal's soul ?

g.title: j380005824->j2930639881
g.text: MarieEntratiFan1

g.title: j380005824->j2930639881
g.text: MarieEntratiFan2

g.title: j3336918350
g.text: I thought you had not made up your mind about le Cardinal ? Or has this now changed ?

g.title: j380005824->j3336918350
g.text: MarieEntratiNeutral

g.title: j2679102564
g.text: Oui. This, I am learning with M'sieur Tagfer...

g.title: j2952898253->j2679102564
g.text: MarieEntrati3a

g.title: j2952898253->j2679102564
g.text: MarieEntrati3b

g.title: j302715288
g.text: Do not speak to me of scabbed wounds, wolf. I am still licking my own from our last discussion of le Cardinal.

g.title: j2952898253->j302715288
g.text: MarieEntrati3

g.title: j949967654
g.text: Oui, but you said it before - we must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer.

g.title: j2952898253->j949967654
g.text: MarieEntratiFamily

g.title: j2082929958
g.text: I know you believe le Cardinal is some kind of horrible monstre for causing such wounds.

g.title: j2952898253->j2082929958
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster1

g.title: j2952898253->j2082929958
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster2

g.title: j1457016139
g.text: I know you are on my side of this war for le Cardinal's soul, for which I shall be forever grateful.

g.title: j2952898253->j1457016139
g.text: MarieEntratiFan1

g.title: j2952898253->j1457016139
g.text: MarieEntratiFan2

g.title: j4285840259
g.text: I know you are withholding judgement on him, for which I am immensely grateful.

g.title: j2952898253->j4285840259
g.text: MarieEntratiNeutral

g.title: j1267825415
g.text: And while I know the others are quick to blame him, I do not wish to see us divided and bleeding when we could be whole.

g.title: j2952898253->j1267825415
g.text: false

g.title: j2515192195->j1457016139
g.text: MarieEntratiFan1

g.title: j2515192195->j1457016139
g.text: MarieEntratiFan2

g.title: j2515192195->j4285840259
g.text: MarieEntratiNeutral

g.title: j547808497
g.text: Oui, though I am learning - as with M'sieur Tagfer, that perhaps not all to the same degree.

g.title: j2515192195->j547808497
g.text: MarieEntrati3a

g.title: j2515192195->j547808497
g.text: MarieEntrati3b

g.title: j3279756362
g.text: And I am learning that it is not all to the same degree, as you were so "kind" to point out to me, non ?

g.title: j2515192195->j3279756362
g.text: MarieEntrati3

g.title: j1844365872
g.text: Oui, yes ! While I do not blame le Cardinal for leaving, for his work is sacro-saint -

g.title: j2515192195->j1844365872
g.text: MarieEntratiFamily

g.title: j83925427
g.text: And I know you believe le Cardinal is some kind of horrible monstre for causing such wounds.

g.title: j2515192195->j83925427
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster1

g.title: j2515192195->j83925427
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster2

g.title: j1055063086
g.text: And while the others are quick to blame him for their pain, I simply do not wish to see us divided and suffering.

g.title: j2515192195->j1055063086
g.text: false

g.title: j666133542
g.text: And what could you possibly be distracted by ? What could be more important than sitting down and sorting through the complaints of mécontents ?

g.title: j3776834607
g.text: What could be difficult about sitting down and sorting through the complaints of mécontents ?

g.title: j2168281754
g.text: Oh, magnifique !

g.title: j3948323697
g.text: Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.

g.title: j2318861824
g.text: I don't know as there's much of a market for Entrati's chairs...

g.title: j649464820
g.text: Wouldn't we flood the market eventually? We'd have to sell them for pretty cheap...

g.title: j600454294
g.text: Brilliant. I see no problems with this.

g.title: j2839778855
g.text: And while I understand the two topics are inexorably linked, I would ask you to keep it productive this day, oui ?

g.title: j693820214
g.text: What is this deception of yours, wolf ? Or is little Marie only un jeu to you ?

g.title: j1404258653
g.text: I haven't made up my mind about the necessity of his actions. But his callous nature can't be questioned.

g.title: j759887391
g.text: I'm tired of pretending, I'm sorry.

g.title: j2584051697
g.text: We must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer.

g.title: j1662883289
g.text: I do not agree with blaming le Cardinal either, mind, but I do not wish to see us divided and bleeding when we could be whole.

g.title: j4262307208
g.text: We must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer, regardless of who is ultimately at fault.

g.title: j335344031
g.text: I tease, I tease ! I cannot fathom how busy you are, and all the places - and times - you are needed.

g.title: j4119544417
g.text: I tease, I tease ! I cannot fathom what they have endured. And how challenging it is for you to untangle it.

g.title: j2412673648
g.text: I simply worry that without their issues mended, we could never hope to be welcome at their table. The greater problem remains unsolved -

g.title: j3916832970
g.text: Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank(syndicate=EntratiSyndicate, syndicateRank=5)

g.title: j3755356140
g.text: Pff ! I still think this is a worthy experiment. Perhaps we can wall off the devil in a sea of bookcases !

g.title: j1284319580
g.text: I am going to dutifully ignore your sarcasm, because I think this is a worthy experiment. Perhaps we can wall off the devil in a sea of bookcases !

g.title: j1254158668
g.text: I seek to aid us all in this... strange coexistence we have found ourselves, not to argue.

g.title: j2609973870
g.text: No, not a game. But Entrati isn't to be trusted, and I don't know how else to convince you but to pretend to be on your side.

g.title: j963343799
g.text: Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you needn't do so any longer.

g.title: j1138016143
g.text: Together, all as one, we are... a strange family. But a family, none the less.

g.title: j3662745807
g.text: We would be stronger together than we are apart.

g.title: j1046041486
g.text: She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.

g.title: j3916832970->j1046041486
g.text: true

g.title: j3337182392
g.text: Check boolean MarieSyndicateMaxRank

g.title: j3916832970->j3337182392
g.text: false

g.title: j827029302
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j291213218
g.text: Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you have failed.

g.title: j1509439757
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan1 is now false.

g.title: j1625808289
g.text: Add +1 to Family counter

g.title: j1731491872
g.text: And in times when we're suffering, sometimes all we really have is each other. Either the ones we were given, or the ones we found.

g.title: j2547484601
g.text: I don't know if it would help, or hurt, in the long run. But this... purgatory, isn't right, either.

g.title: j728491544
g.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?

g.title: j3337182392->j1046041486
g.text: true

g.title: j340274257
g.text: She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.

g.title: j3337182392->j340274257
g.text: false

g.title: j2901110044
g.text: Much to do ! À la revoyure !

g.title: j2631316640
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan2 is now false.

g.title: j1637573316
g.text: Add +1 to Family counter

g.title: j799392373
g.text: Oui, I agree. But I cannot be the one to bridge the gap between us. I don't know how to do it ! I am a stranger to them upstairs...

g.title: j3018318990
g.text: I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.

g.title: j314197745
g.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?

g.title: j1508231473
g.text: Boolean MarieNoDate is now true.

g.title: j2447986332
g.text: Loid knew the Entrati family. It should be him. Convincing him, however... is another matter.

g.title: j323424232
g.text: Roathe, maybe? He's Orokin, he knew them all.

g.title: j762413590
g.text: While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...

g.title: j4154174968
g.text: It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.

g.title: j3788512162
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j140210410
g.text: Non, not the devil - anyone but the devil. But you are on to something. The natural choice is Monsieur Loid, non ?

g.title: j3193079653
g.text: I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?

g.title: j2054531075
g.text: Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.

g.title: j2089407382
g.text: Oui, oui ! C'est ça ! But how do we convince him ? He has been stalwart in his position, non ?

g.title: j22751870
g.text: But how do we convince him ? He has been stalwart in his position, non ?

g.title: j4154999171
g.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.

g.title: j1753988278
g.text: It's not really my decision to make.

g.title: j468490440
g.text: What would you suggest I do?

g.title: j3105854715
g.text: Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.

g.title: j4217253801
g.text: Do you think you or Lyon might convince him?

g.title: j3390487446
g.text: You're not going to like my answer, Marie...

g.title: j3840142459
g.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.

g.title: j1050259230
g.text: I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.

g.title: j1899539653
g.text: I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.

g.title: j4002007537
g.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.

g.title: j3676510582
g.text: I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.

g.title: j147620024
g.text: He likes us well enough, he is kind and he is gentle. But we are étrangers to him, newcomers.

g.title: j422744456
g.text: Ah bon ?

g.title: j995006244
g.text: That we hide some great and terrible sin.

g.title: j4203774723
g.text: Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.

g.title: j1849588085
g.text: I will think on it. You do the same ! A solution will be found, Sol has guided us this far !

g.title: j1805475671
g.text: Loid might listen to Roathe. Him being Orokin - their shared history - might come in handy, here.

g.title: j364455316
g.text: And it is that sin that must be forgiven, or proven to be false, perhaps ?

g.title: j3229234412
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j1925107010
g.text: Non ! He is a liar, he is a manipulator, he would only do this in exchange for some great fee !

g.title: j1924511960
g.text: The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.

g.title: j2919405780
g.text: We just have to be careful. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."

g.title: j3261569741
g.text: We will find a way to convince Monsieur Loid to walk up those stairs... I know it.

g.title: j2169696619
g.text: We will find another way to convince Monsieur Loid to walk up those stairs... I know it.

g.title: j1568440548
g.text: You would be surprised how resilient the soul is. And those that surround me now are so very old, so very tempered by time.

g.title: j3705427231
g.text: Add +1 to Family counter

g.title: j1757606201
g.text: I must go. Much to think on, much to do. À la revoyure.

g.title: j3812003427
g.text: I must go. Much to think on, much to do. À la revoyure.

g.title: j1270948402
g.text: You have surprised them many times. Let them surprise you this once.

g.title: j422108378
g.text: Oh Sol, I think you may have solved it !

g.title: j3419468122
g.text: Boolean MarieFamily3b is now true.

g.title: j3493145735
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j3250607025
g.text: But what is the direction we take, oui ? We must find a means to convince them.

g.title: j2659855420
g.text: Boolean MarieFamilyOther is now true.

g.title: j2660382074
g.text: Boolean MarieFamily3a is now true.

g.title: j1994668253
g.text: I am beside myself with excitement - je suis assise ici, remuant sur ma chaise !
